summary: Proved a hybrid-stable perturbation threshold for the PGM outcome-garbage bootstrap. With inverse-polynomial PGM success, an aligned accessible dilation needs only inverse-polynomial operator precision to recover approximate canonical fiber erasure. Outcome-only and average-state approximation contracts remain open.
